_doc: Time per stage, measured on this project unless marked estimate. rate = seconds of work per second of video (video length, not wall clock). who: machine = MacBook local tools (0 Claude tokens), claude = LLM judgement, owner = you. Edit the numbers when a stage gets faster.

stages.prep: Run once per machine; the Whisper model (461 MB) downloads on first use, so do it before the first video.

stages.stage: Azure container and Key Vault secrets
stages.prep: One command, one time. Do it before the first upload.

stages.stage: Scaffold the project from the kit
stages.prep: Fill project.json and assets/okr.json while the next stage runs.

stages.stage: Sync clips to the voice recording
stages.prep: Keep clips and the WAV in one folder.
Source resolution does not matter much; the blurred side fill keeps the whole screen.
Start it the moment the sync is done, it only needs the audio.

stages.stage: OCR of the screen every 2 s (Apple Vision)
stages.prep: Cached in assets/ocr_frames.json, so a second pass costs nothing.

stages.stage: Read REPORT.md, write slides, cuts, speed-ups, ending, OKRs
stages.llm: medium: reads one page of text, writes JSON
stages.prep: Have the title, community and sensitive words in project.json first; think about the platform highlights while the transcript exists.

stages.stage: Blur boxes from OCR, noise check
Stills and Studio check of the new edits
stages.basis: estimate (5 min, about 15 s per still)
stages.llm: low: look at a few stills
stages.prep: Render a still only for moments that changed; use render --scale=0.5 for a quick look.

stages.basis: measured (about 13 frames/s idle; 21,576 frames took about 28 min)
stages.prep: Do not run OCR or other heavy jobs during a render: it dropped to 5 to 9 frames/s when I did.

stages.basis: measured (same speed; scales with the cut length)
stages.parallel: queue them right after YouTube in one command
stages.prep: Choose the keep ranges before the YouTube render finishes so the queue never waits.
Run it on the YouTube file while you choose platform ranges.

stages.stage: Upload to Azure and make read-only links
stages.basis: estimate (about 130 MB; depends on your upload speed)

stages.stage: You watch in the player and write notes
stages.basis: estimate (1.5x the video length per pass)
stages.prep: Notes are tagged with the version, so they can be read any time.

stages.stage: Turn the notes into edits (each extra round)
stages.basis: estimate (15 to 30 min for about 8 notes)
stages.prep: Batch all notes into one round: one render, not one per note.

stages.stage: Commit, push, merge, backup, fill the post links

prep.do: Install and check everything first (check_env.sh); download the Whisper model once
prep.saves: 5 to 10 min on the first video

prep.do: Create the Azure container and Key Vault secrets once (setup_azure_exports.sh)
Start Whisper as soon as the sync is done; it runs while the base video renders
Keep the machine idle while Remotion renders (no OCR, no builds, no tests)
prep.saves: 10 to 20 min per render: 13 vs 5 to 9 frames/s

prep.do: Make the base video with the index at the front (faststart)
Collect all review notes, then render once per round
Use quick previews: a still for one moment, or render --scale=0.5 / --frames=a-b for a section
Pick the LinkedIn and X highlight ranges while the YouTube render runs, then queue all platforms in one command
Run the privacy check on the YouTube file while choosing platform cuts
Keep caches: OCR, transcript and the registry are reused, never redone
Fill project.json (title, community, sensitive words) and okr.json before editing
prep.saves: re-renders caused by a missed word or name

prep.do: Keep the recording clean: no notifications, no other windows, quiet room
prep.saves: blur work, a hoover cut, apology cards
